title: MAI HAƁAKA MANHAJAR SDR
meta: Salary aligned with the market + typical French benefits (Health Insurance, 50% Transportation card)
html:
Nauyin Aiki

Wanda aka zaɓa zai ɗauki nauyin waɗannan ayyuka:

  • Tsarawa da haɓaka hanyoyin warware matsaloli na rediyo masu aiki da manhaja (SDR),
  • Fahimtar dabarun SDR da kawo sababbin ra'ayoyi,
  • Gina da kula da tsarin sarrafa nunawa bisa tsauraran sharuɗɗan inganci da ƙarancin jinkiri,
  • Aiki kafaɗa da kafaɗa da masu tsara na'urorin lantarki,
  • Aiki tare da masu zane, ƙungiyoyin kayayyaki da injiniyoyin tsare-tsare
  • Shiga cikin yanke shawarwari kan tsarin gine-ginen manhaja da dabarun fasaha na dogon lokaci na na'urar sauya sigina
  • Rubuta takardun bayanin fasaha masu inganci da duba lambobin manhaja a matakin ƙwararre

Ƙwarewar Fasaha da Ake Buƙata

  • Zurfin ilimi a lissafin SDR (aljabarar layi, sauye-sauyen lissafi, tsinkaye)
  • Ƙwarewa mai ƙarfi wajen haɓaka rediyo masu aiki da manhaja
  • Gogewa ta zahiri a fannin SDR da PCB
  • Gogewar aiki a ƙarƙashin sharuɗɗan lokaci na ainihi (kasafin lokacin kowane firam, jinkiri, tazara tsakanin motsi da bayyanar hoto)
  • Harsunan shirye-shirye: C / Rust / ASM

Game da Kai

  • Gogewar aiki ta shekaru 3 zuwa 10 a fannin haɓaka manhaja, tare da mai da hankali sosai kan SDR
  • Tabbataccen tarihin aiki kan tsare-tsare masu sarƙaƙiya da muhimmanci a fannin fasaha
  • Ƙwaƙƙwaran tunani a fannin SDR da iya fahimtar manyan tarin lambobin manhaja da ake da su
  • Matuƙar tsantseni, dogaro da kai da kula da ƙananan bayanai, tare da sha'awar warware matsalolin fasaha masu wuyar sha'ani
  • Ƙwarewar da za ta zama ƙari: Tsara na'urorin lantarki
  • Ƙwarewar da za ta zama ƙari: Gudummawa ga manhajoji na buɗaɗɗen tushe

Matakan Hira

  1. Kiran Tantancewa na Minti 15: Ɗan taƙaitaccen tattaunawa kan ƙwarin gwiwarka, dacewarka da kuma amsa tambayoyinka da ba na fasaha ba.
  2. Hirar Fasaha da Kayayyaki ta Awa Ɗaya, Sau Biyu: Zurfafa nazari kan yadda kake tunkarar warware matsaloli tare da CTO ɗinmu da/ko babban mai tsara hanyoyin warware matsalolinmu
  3. Ganawa da Ƙungiya: Zama na sakin jiki domin tabbatar da kana dacewa da al'adunmu na aiki.

Abin da Muke Bayarwa

  • Aiki kan fasahohin XR da na'ura mai fahimtar sararin samaniya na zamani
  • Ikon jagorantar tsare-tsaren lokaci na ainihi masu ƙalubale a fannin fasaha
  • Ayyuka masu zurfin fasaha da ke ƙalubalantar basira
  • Yanayin aiki da ke daraja ƙwarewar injiniya ta gaskiya kuma ya mai da hankali kan fasaha (babu taruka ko rahotanni marasa amfani)
  • Cikakken 'yancin yanke shawarwari a fannin fasaha
